name: Phoenix
description: Phoenix is Knoebels' signature wooden coaster. It was built in 1947 as The Rocket and moved to Knoebels in 1985. It stands about 24 m high and reaches 72 km/h. Min 122cm alone, 107cm with a companion.

name: Twister
description: Twister is a wooden coaster that opened on 24 July 1999. It stands about 31 m high and reaches 82 km/h on a twisting layout. Min 107cm.

name: Flying Turns
description: Flying Turns is a wooden bobsled coaster that opened on 5 October 2013, one of the very few of its kind in the world. Riders sit in toboggan-style cars that glide down a tube-like wooden track at up to 39 km/h. Min 122cm alone, 107cm with a companion.

name: Impulse
description: Impulse is a steel launch coaster that opened on 25 April 2015. It is about 30 m high, reaches 89 km/h and takes riders through four inversions. Min 132cm alone, 122cm with a companion.

name: Black Diamond
description: Black Diamond is an enclosed steel coaster that opened in 2011 on the site of the former Golden Nugget (1960). Riders travel through a dark indoor course at a modest speed. Min 107cm.

name: Kozmo's Kurves
description: Kozmo's Kurves is a small steel coaster for young children that opened in 2009. Min 91cm.

name: StratosFear
description: StratosFear is a SuperShot drop tower that opened on 27 April 2013. Riders are shot up a tower about 45 m (148 ft) high and bounce back down at speeds of around 76 km/h. Min 122cm.

name: Haunted Mansion
description: Haunted Mansion is a classic dark ride that opened in 1973. Riders travel through spooky scenes in a small car. No height limit is listed.

name: Cosmotron
description: Cosmotron is a Himalaya-type spinning ride that opened in 1998. Min 122cm alone, 107cm with a companion.

name: Giant Flume
description: Giant Flume is a log flume water ride that opened in 1990. Min 107cm alone, 91cm with a companion.

name: Sklooosh!
description: Sklooosh! (spelled "Sklooosh" on the official list) is a shoot-the-chute water ride that opened on 4 July 1997. A boat climbs a lift, drops down a slope and sends up a giant splash. Min 102cm alone, 91cm with a companion.

name: Grand Carousel
description: The Grand Carousel was built in 1913 and has operated at Knoebels since 1942. It has 63 horses and 3 chariots. No height limit is listed.

name: Giant Wheel
description: The Giant Wheel is a Ferris wheel that opened in 1991 and rises to about 34 m (110 ft). No height limit is listed.

name: Antique Cars
description: Antique Cars is a gentle ride that opened in 1990, where riders drive vintage-style cars. Check the height rule on the day.

name: Pioneer Train
description: The Pioneer Train is a train ride dating from 1960, covering about 1.5 miles around the park. No height limit is listed.
